evals.prompt: I want to run CloudGrid locally from the release bundle and send a test trace. Tell me the single supported path and what files or commands to inspect first.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-setup-configuration, points to deploy/compose/cloudgrid-local.sh and release compose docs, avoids mutable latest tags, and includes a verification step.
assertions: Mentions deploy/compose/cloudgrid-local.sh
Mentions release Compose docs or deploy/compose files
Does not recommend mutable latest image tags
Includes a verification step

evals.prompt: We need GitHub SSO plus SMTP invites in deployed mode. Check what env vars are valid and explain the onboarding flow without inventing magic links.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-setup-configuration, reads runtime and invitation docs/code, explains SSO identity plus invite acceptance, and names only implemented env vars.
assertions: Mentions checked-in environment variable docs or runtime validation
Mentions invitation lifecycle or SMTP invitation email docs
Does not invent undocumented environment variables
Does not invent magic-link behavior

evals.prompt: The storage-read service is returning too many metric rows. Update the query path so filtering and grouping happen in the database adapter.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-surrealdb or cloudgrid-extension-development, respects storage-read ownership, avoids BFF/frontend aggregation, and calls for focused Go tests.
assertions: Keeps query semantics in storage-read
Rejects BFF or frontend aggregation of telemetry records
Mentions SurrealDB adapter or storage-read database adapter
Requires focused Go tests

evals.prompt: Add a new dashboard widget backed by public GraphQL and make sure the frontend and integration scenarios don't drift.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-observability-ui and cloudgrid-extension-development, updates contracts/docs first if needed, uses public API client operations, and requires contracts:check.
assertions: Reports missing behavior as a product gap before implementation
Mentions public GraphQL schema or generated UI contracts
Mentions public API client or integration scenarios
Requires bun run contracts:check

evals.prompt: Our release workflow failed while building Docker images. Review what should be produced for a release and what checks to run before we retry.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-operations-maintenance, follows release docs and workflow files, checks image/artifact requirements, and uses release validation without adding long-lived registry secrets.
assertions: Mentions release docs, deploy files, or release workflow files
Mentions release artifact or Docker image validation
Mentions bun run release:validate
Does not add long-lived registry secrets

evals.prompt: Document how a company admin enables AI Chat, configures the provider, and explains why Azure AI Foundry cannot execute yet in the bundled runtime.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-ai-chat-operations, explains the company provider route, managed credential behavior, supported bundled harness adapters, bounded unsupported-adapter failure, and avoids raw secrets.
assertions: Mentions /organizations/:organizationId/ai-provider
Mentions managed company credential references or write-only credentialValue
Says bundled AI Chat execution supports openai, anthropic, and openai_compatible
Says azure_foundry requires a matching PURISTA harness adapter before AI Chat execution
Does not include raw API key examples

evals.prompt: Review an AI Chat artifact proposal that includes a cloudgrid-json-render fence and an approval button. What must be true before the frontend can render or execute it?
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-ai-chat-operations and cloudgrid-json-render-artifacts, requires persisted BFF artifact parts for trusted fences, approved renderer keys, server-issued action proposal IDs, and approval through GraphQL only.
assertions: Requires a persisted BFF artifact part or artifact ID for trusted json-render fences
Mentions approved json-render renderer keys
Requires server-issued AiChatActionProposal IDs
Says the frontend must not execute actions from assistant text or copied JSON

evals.prompt: I want to add a new AI Chat tool that reads telemetry and a new specialist skill for it. Outline the source files and checks without adding a generic GraphQL tool.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-ai-chat-operations, reads AI Chat runtime code and generated contracts, keeps telemetry semantics in storage-read, updates the runtime catalog and skill evals, and requires contracts and skills checks.
assertions: Mentions AI Chat route, BFF code, or public docs
Mentions generated contracts or public API client operations
Rejects a generic GraphQL tool
Keeps telemetry query semantics in storage-read
Mentions bun run contracts:check and bun run skills:check

evals.prompt: Explain how a project admin should enable AI Eval, create a dataset, add candidates and scorers, run an experiment, and use production quality monitoring without leaking provider secrets or inventing unsupported alerting.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-ai-eval-investigation, follows the website AI Eval guide and implemented contracts, explains the setup-to-run workflow, names production quality as monitoring rather than realtime alerting, and keeps secrets private.
assertions: Mentions website/src/content/handbook/guides/ai-eval.md
Mentions datasets, dataset candidates, scorers, and experiments
Says production quality is monitoring, not realtime alerting
Does not expose raw provider credentials or bearer tokens
Does not invent unsupported AI Eval routes, GraphQL fields, or alerting behavior

evals.prompt: Create a customer whitelabel build for CloudGrid named Acme Observe with a custom mark, product name, page titles, and theme colors. Do not add settings pages.
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-whitelabel-customization, implements the customer brand through @cloudgrid/brand/ProductBrand and CLOUDGRID_FRONTEND_BRAND_MODULE, keeps route code/core CSS generic, and avoids runtime brand settings.
assertions: Mentions @cloudgrid/brand or ProductBrand
Mentions CLOUDGRID_FRONTEND_BRAND_MODULE
Does not add a frontend settings page for branding
Keeps customer-specific values in a brand module
Requires complete light and dark semantic token sets

evals.prompt: Review a PR that hard-codes a customer's blue into AppShell buttons and adds a GraphQL mutation to save organization branding. What should be changed?
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-whitelabel-customization, rejects route-level brand colors and GraphQL branding, requires semantic tokens and build-time brand module replacement only.
assertions: Rejects hard-coded customer colors in route components
Rejects GraphQL or backend branding mutations
Requires semantic Tailwind/CSS tokens
Says whitelabeling is build-time/code-level only
Keeps telemetry, auth, route, and storage behavior unchanged

evals.prompt: A customer brand module compiles after omitting sidebarRing and chart5 by falling back to CloudGrid defaults. Is that acceptable?
evals.expected_output: Uses cloudgrid-whitelabel-customization, rejects partial token overrides, explains that complete light/dark token sets are required so missing tokens fail typecheck.
assertions: Rejects partial token overrides
Requires sidebarRing and chart5 when part of ProductBrand token set
Says missing required tokens should fail typecheck
Does not recommend implicit fallback to CloudGrid brand values
